requirements.description: One read-only bounded SQLite query executes against the protected public fixture
Exact required SQL fields, text keys, integer values and nullable total fields
Each eligible observed workload once; correct tenant, currency and base value
Allocated charge row counts, null counts and known signed subtotals
Allocated credit row counts, null counts and known signed subtotals
Correct known flag and NULL/zero/value distinction for charge coverage, nulls and currency defects
Correct known flag and NULL/zero/value distinction for credit coverage, nulls and currency defects
Workload signed net only if both streams are known
Machine-readable observed-extract scope and exact public parameters
Every control partition, independent counts/base deltas, and supported population-complete flag
Known/unknown workload counts, partial subtotal, observed/full totals, including empty and known nonempty partitions
Entire eligible feed counts/nulls/known subtotals and independent control deltas separately per stream/currency
Retain every eligible unallocated event with original values and correct precedence-based reason
Every affected workload-stream with all supported reasons; no invented unknowns

unassessed_policy: Execution failure leaves dependent SQL requirements unknown; unavailable/invalid JSON fails scope_parameters and leaves dependent JSON requirements unknown. Structured mismatches fail their declared checks. Unknowns remain in scheduled denominators.
